verses.original: Ἄγε νῦν οἱ πλούσιοι κλαύσατε ὀλολύζοντες ἐπὶ ταῖς ταλαιπωρίαις ὑμῶν ταῖς ἐπερχομέναις
verses.transliteration: Age nyn hoi plousioi klausate ololyzontes epi tais talaipōriais hymōn tais eperchomenais
verses.literal: Come now you who are rich weep and wail over the misery to come upon you
verses.literalPt: EIA, pois, agora vós, ricos, chorai e pranteai, por vossas misérias, que sobre vós hão de vir.

verses.original: ὁ πλοῦτος ὑμῶν σέσηπεν καὶ τὰ ἱμάτια ὑμῶν σητόβρωτα γέγονεν
verses.transliteration: ho ploutos hymōn sesēpen kai ta himatia hymōn sētobrōta gegonen
verses.literal: Your riches have rotted and moths have eaten your clothes
verses.literalPt: As vossas riquezas estão apodrecidas, e as vossas vestes estão comidas de traça.

verses.original: ὁ χρυσὸς ὑμῶν καὶ ὁ ἄργυρος κατίωται καὶ ὁ ἰὸς αὐτῶν εἰς μαρτύριον ὑμῖν ἔσται καὶ φάγεται τὰς σάρκας ὑμῶν ὡς πῦρ Ἐθησαυρίσατε ἐν ἐσχάταις ἡμέραις
verses.transliteration: ho chrysos hymōn kai ho argyros katiōtai kai ho ios autōn eis martyrion hymin estai kai phagetai tas sarkas hymōn hōs pyr Ethēsaurisate en eschatais hēmerais
verses.literal: Your gold and silver are corroded Their corrosion will testify against you and consume your flesh like fire You have hoarded treasure in the last days
verses.literalPt: O vosso ouro e a vossa prata se enferrujaram; e a sua ferrugem dará testemunho contra vós, e comerá como fogo a vossa carne. Entesourastes para os últimos dias.

verses.original: ἰδοὺ ὁ μισθὸς τῶν ἐργατῶν τῶν ἀμησάντων τὰς χώρας ὑμῶν ὁ ἀφυστερημένος ἀφ’ ὑμῶν κράζει καὶ αἱ βοαὶ τῶν θερισάντων εἰς τὰ ὦτα Κυρίου Σαβαὼθ εἰσεληλύθασιν
verses.transliteration: idou ho misthos tōn ergatōn tōn amēsantōn tas chōras hymōn ho aphysterēmenos aph’ hymōn krazei kai hai boai tōn therisantōn eis ta ōta Kyriou Sabaōth eiselēlythasin
verses.literal: Look the wages you withheld from the workmen who mowed your fields are crying out against you The cries of the harvesters have reached . . . the ears of the Lord of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Eis que o jornal dos trabalhadores que ceifaram as vossas terras, e que por vós foi diminuído, clama; e os clamores dos que ceifaram entraram nos ouvidos do Senhor dos exércitos.

verses.original: Ἐτρυφήσατε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐσπαταλήσατε ἐθρέψατε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ σφαγῆς
verses.transliteration: Etryphēsate epi tēs gēs kai espatalēsate ethrepsate tas kardias hymōn en hēmera sphagēs
verses.literal: You have lived on earth in luxury and self-indulgence You have fattened your hearts in the day of slaughter
verses.literalPt: Deliciosamente vivestes sobre a terra, e vos deleitastes; cevastes os vossos corações, como num dia de matança.

verses.original: κατεδικάσατε ἐφονεύσατε τὸν δίκαιον οὐκ ἀντιτάσσεται ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: katedikasate ephoneusate ton dikaion ouk antitassetai hymin
verses.literal: You have condemned and murdered the righteous who did not resist you
verses.literalPt: Condenastes e matastes o justo; ele não vos resistiu.

verses.original: Μακροθυμήσατε οὖν ἀδελφοί ἕως τῆς παρουσίας τοῦ Κυρίου ἰδοὺ ὁ γεωργὸς ἐκδέχεται τὸν τίμιον καρπὸν τῆς γῆς μακροθυμῶν ἐπ’ αὐτῷ ἕως λάβῃ πρόϊμον καὶ ὄψιμον
verses.transliteration: Makrothymēsate oun adelphoi heōs tēs parousias tou Kyriou idou ho geōrgos ekdechetai ton timion karpon tēs gēs makrothymōn ep’ autō heōs labē proimon kai opsimon
verses.literal: Be patient then brothers until the Lord’s coming See how the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the soil how patient he is for . . . . . . . . . the fall and spring rains
verses.literalPt: Sede pois, irmãos, pacientes até à vinda do Senhor. Eis que o lavrador espera o precioso fruto da terra, aguardando-o com paciência, até que receba a chuva temporã e serôdia.

verses.original: μακροθυμήσατε καὶ ὑμεῖς στηρίξατε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὅτι ἡ παρουσία τοῦ Κυρίου ἤγγικεν
verses.transliteration: makrothymēsate kai hymeis stērixate tas kardias hymōn hoti hē parousia tou Kyriou ēngiken
verses.literal: You too be patient and strengthen your hearts because the Lord’s coming is near
verses.literalPt: Sede vós também pacientes, fortalecei os vossos corações; porque já a vinda do Senhor está próxima.

verses.original: μὴ στενάζετε ἀδελφοί κατ’ ἀλλήλων ἵνα μὴ κριθῆτε ἰδοὺ ὁ κριτὴς πρὸ τῶν θυρῶν ἕστηκεν
verses.transliteration: mē stenazete adelphoi kat’ allēlōn hina mē krithēte idou ho kritēs pro tōn thyrōn hestēken
verses.literal: Do not complain about one another brothers so that you will not be judged Look the Judge is standing at the door
verses.literalPt: Irmãos, não vos queixeis uns contra os outros, para que não sejais condenados. Eis que o juiz está à porta.

verses.original: Ὑπόδειγμα λάβετε ἀδελφοί τῆς κακοπαθίας καὶ τῆς μακροθυμίας τοὺς προφήτας οἳ ἐλάλησαν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: Hypodeigma labete adelphoi tēs kakopathias kai tēs makrothymias tous prophētas hoi elalēsan en tō onomati Kyriou
verses.literal: Brothers as an example - of patience in affliction take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord
verses.literalPt: Meus irmãos, tomai por exemplo de aflição e paciência os profetas que falaram em nome do Senhor.

verses.original: ἰδοὺ μακαρίζομεν τοὺς ὑπομείναντας τὴν ὑπομονὴν Ἰὼβ ἠκούσατε καὶ τὸ τέλος Κυρίου εἴδετε ὅτι πολύσπλαγχνός ἐστιν ὁ Κύριος καὶ οἰκτίρμων
verses.transliteration: idou makarizomen tous hypomeinantas tēn hypomonēn Iōb ēkousate kai to telos Kyriou eidete hoti polysplanchnos estin ho Kyrios kai oiktirmōn
verses.literal: See how blessed we consider those who have persevered You have heard of Job’s perseverance and have seen the outcome from the Lord The Lord is full of compassion and mercy
verses.literalPt: Eis que temos por bem-aventurados os que sofreram. Ouvistes qual foi a paciência de Jó, e vistes o fim que o Senhor lhe deu; porque o Senhor é muito misericordioso e piedoso.

verses.original: Πρὸ πάντων δέ ἀδελφοί μου μὴ ὀμνύετε μήτε τὸν οὐρανὸν μήτε τὴν γῆν μήτε ἄλλον τινὰ ὅρκον ἤτω δὲ ὑμῶν τὸ Ναὶ ναί καὶ τὸ Οὒ οὔ ἵνα μὴ ὑπὸ κρίσιν πέσητε
verses.transliteration: Pro pantōn de adelphoi mou mē omnyete mēte ton ouranon mēte tēn gēn mēte allon tina horkon ētō de hymōn to Nai nai kai to Ou ou hina mē hypo krisin pesēte
verses.literal: Above all my brothers do not swear not by heaven or earth or by any other oath Simply let your Yes be yes and your No no so that you will not fall under judgment
verses.literalPt: Mas, sobretudo, meus irmãos, não jureis, nem pelo céu, nem pela terra, nem façais qualquer outro juramento; mas que a vossa palavra seja sim, sim, e não, não; para que não caiais em condenação.

verses.original: Κακοπαθεῖ τις ἐν ὑμῖν προσευχέσθω εὐθυμεῖ τις ψαλλέτω
verses.transliteration: Kakopathei tis en hymin proseuchesthō euthymei tis psalletō
verses.literal: Is any one of you suffering He should pray Is anyone cheerful He should sing praises
verses.literalPt: Está alguém entre vós aflito? Ore. Está alguém contente? Cante louvores.

verses.original: ἀσθενεῖ τις ἐν ὑμῖν προσκαλεσάσθω τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους τῆς ἐκκλησίας καὶ προσευξάσθωσαν ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ἀλείψαντες αὐτὸν ἐλαίῳ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: asthenei tis en hymin proskalesasthō tous presbyterous tēs ekklēsias kai proseuxasthōsan ep’ auton aleipsantes auton elaiō en tō onomati tou Kyriou
verses.literal: Is any one of you sick He should call the elders of the church to pray over him and anoint him with oil in the name of the Lord
verses.literalPt: Está alguém entre vós doente? Chame os presbíteros da igreja, e orem sobre ele, ungindo-o com azeite em nome do Senhor;

verses.original: καὶ ἡ εὐχὴ τῆς πίστεως σώσει τὸν κάμνοντα καὶ ἐγερεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ Κύριος κἂν ἁμαρτίας ᾖ πεποιηκώς ἀφεθήσεται αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai hē euchē tēs pisteōs sōsei ton kamnonta kai egerei auton ho Kyrios kan hamartias ē pepoiēkōs aphethēsetai autō
verses.literal: And the prayer offered in faith will restore the one who is sick The Lord will raise him up . . . If he has sinned . . . he will be forgiven . . .
verses.literalPt: E a oração da fé salvará o doente, e o Senhor o levantará; e, se houver cometido pecados, ser-lhe-ão perdoados.

verses.original: Ἐξομολογεῖσθε οὖν ἀλλήλοις τὰς ἁμαρτίας καὶ εὔχεσθε ὑπὲρ ἀλλήλων ὅπως ἰαθῆτε πολὺ ἰσχύει δέησις δικαίου ἐνεργουμένη
verses.transliteration: Exomologeisthe oun allēlois tas hamartias kai euchesthe hyper allēlōn hopōs iathēte poly ischyei deēsis dikaiou energoumenē
verses.literal: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed The prayer of a righteous man has great power to prevail
verses.literalPt: Confessai as vossas culpas uns aos outros, e orai uns pelos outros, para que sareis. A oração feita por um justo pode muito em seus efeitos.

verses.original: Ἠλίας ἄνθρωπος ἦν ὁμοιοπαθὴς ἡμῖν καὶ προσευχῇ προσηύξατο τοῦ μὴ βρέξαι καὶ οὐκ ἔβρεξεν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἐνιαυτοὺς τρεῖς καὶ μῆνας ἕξ
verses.transliteration: Ēlias anthrōpos ēn homoiopathēs hēmin kai proseuchē prosēuxato tou mē brexai kai ouk ebrexen epi tēs gēs eniautous treis kai mēnas hex
verses.literal: Elijah was a man just like us He prayed earnestly . . . that it would not rain and it did not rain on the land for three and a half . . . years
verses.literalPt: Elias era homem sujeito às mesmas paixões que nós e, orando, pediu que não chovesse e, por três anos e seis meses, não choveu sobre a terra.

verses.original: καὶ πάλιν προσηύξατο καὶ ὁ οὐρανὸς ὑετὸν ἔδωκεν καὶ ἡ γῆ ἐβλάστησεν τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: kai palin prosēuxato kai ho ouranos hyeton edōken kai hē gē eblastēsen ton karpon autēs
verses.literal: Again he prayed and the heavens gave rain and the earth yielded its crops
verses.literalPt: E orou outra vez, e o céu deu chuva, e a terra produziu o seu fruto.

verses.original: Ἀδελφοί μου ἐάν τις ἐν ὑμῖν πλανηθῇ ἀπὸ τῆς ἀληθείας καὶ ἐπιστρέψῃ τις αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Adelphoi mou ean tis en hymin planēthē apo tēs alētheias kai epistrepsē tis auton
verses.literal: My brothers if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring him back . . .
verses.literalPt: Irmãos, se algum dentre vós se tem desviado da verdade, e alguém o converter,

verses.original: γινωσκέτω ὅτι ὁ ἐπιστρέψας ἁμαρτωλὸν ἐκ πλάνης ὁδοῦ αὐτοῦ σώσει ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἐκ θανάτου καὶ καλύψει πλῆθος ἁμαρτιῶν
verses.transliteration: ginōsketō hoti ho epistrepsas hamartōlon ek planēs hodou autou sōsei psychēn autou ek thanatou kai kalypsei plēthos hamartiōn
verses.literal: consider this Whoever turns a sinner from the error of his way will save his soul from death and cover over a multitude of sins
verses.literalPt: Saiba que aquele que fizer converter do erro do seu caminho um pecador, salvará da morte uma alma, e cobrirá uma multidão de pecados.
